note: A-X-M's curated HD texture pack list. Each pack names where it comes from and what it needs; A-X-M downloads it into ROOT\TEXTURES and links it into the emulator's own textures folder. Credits are shown in Game > About & Credits.

packs.name: Crash Twinsanity HD Texture Pack
packs.author: CRASHARKI
packs.notes: Characters, crates, UI, level cards and icons. Delete the old replacements before updating, as the author says.

packs.name: MGS2 HD UI
packs.author: NathanHigley
packs.notes: HUD and menus redrawn in HD.

packs.name: Xbox Texture Pack
packs.author: eternights
packs.notes: The Xbox release's textures ported to PCSX2.

packs.name: WipEout Fusion HD Texture Pack
packs.author: sethvm / NR74W
packs.notes: Turn on Precache Textures in PCSX2 too, as the pack's notes say.

packs.name: AC2AA HD 4x
packs.author: KaedeIchigo
packs.notes: Two zip parts, both downloaded. Community testing release.

packs.name: MK Armageddon HD Textures
packs.author: ckiscxrsed
packs.notes: AI-upscaled. The release is a .rar; 7-Zip unpacks it.

packs.name: Parasite Eve 2 HD Remaster
packs.author: faligame
packs.notes: Includes a DuckStation-compatible HD texture engine. No public release yet - the download waits until the author publishes one.
